{{Quote|How did I lose my arm? A stormtrooper tapped me on the shoulder with a force pike.|Rebel soldier Char'Shen Larcuna|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>}}
'''Force pike''', also referred to as an '''energy pike''', '''stun pike''', or '''stun pole''', was the name of several similar weapons that evolved independently between races and civilizations throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
[[File:ForcePikeschematic.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Force pike schematic]]
Force pikes were two-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] long [[Polearm/Legends|polearms]] constructed from flexible spun [[graphite]] that allowed the weapon to bend and flex rather than break under pressure. They were lightweight weapons, weighing less than seven [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], allowing a skilled wielder to move them rapidly. The long weapon was well suited to thrusting attacks, and its longer reach allowed it to be used more precisely than a standard [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]].<ref name="EGWT" />

A [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibro-weapon]], force pikes featured an [[Ultrasonic generator/Legends|ultrasonic vibration generator]] that was energized by a [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]]. The ultrasonic charge was transmitted up the pike through [[conductive circuit]]s to the [[power tip]] at the top which emitted thousands of microscopic vibrations per [[Standard second|second]]. Force pikes could also produce a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] charge from the power tip through conductive [[shock-filament]]s if moved to within four [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] of a target that was capable of incapacitating a full grown-[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]].<ref name="EGWT" />

The blade's rapid motion allowed it to slice through most materials, including [[Stone/Legends|stone]], metal, flesh, and [[Bone/Legends|bone]]. Glancing blows could cause serious injuries, and the blade was extremely sharp and capable of cutting even with the ultrasonic vibration generator deactivated. The ultrasonic generator was located at the opposite end of the weapon to the power tip, alongside the [[shock generator]]. The shaft featured an insulated handgrip over a series of [[Energy Cycling Coil]]s.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
[[File:Boushh-BetweenTheShadows.png|thumb|left|200px|Bounty hunter [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] wielding a force pike]]
[[Honor guard]]s assigned to diplomatic duty were often equipped with force pikes. They were also commonly used for crowd control situations when the use of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] was considered to be inappropriate.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Force pikes were introduced in the [[Begali Uprising]]. [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] used force pikes during the [[Dark Wars]] to hunt Jedi across the galaxy. They were also utilized by [[Atris]]'s [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]]. The Sith Lords used them during training exercises such as the one Darth Plagueis and Darth Sidious undertook on [[Kursid]].

Force pikes were powerful enough to withstand the blow of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]; the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[X2]] owned one during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and his brother, [[X1]], used it to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Force pikes were generally used by [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guards]]. The meter-long pike was used to keep any person away from important figures.

While most prominently displayed by the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] Royal Guards, who carried the popular [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] [[Controller FP/Legends|Controller FP]] model, force pikes were employed by a wide variety of planetary militias and police forces, including [[Nirama's public asteroid]] security forces.<ref name="TW">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: TopWorld}}</ref> They were excellent for crowd control. Force pikes were often employed during boarding actions because they allowed attackers to slice through bulkheads and airlocks and could be operated in small hallways.

Force pikes were used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] during the beginning of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The stormtrooper [[Imperial Navy/Legends|forces]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] and Admiral [[Kazz]] used them instead of an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]].
